Chk_piles.label: Pile layout validity
Chk_piles.basis: Minimum spacing, edge clearance and integer pile count; see geometry checks.

Chk_loads.label: Load input validity
Chk_loads.basis: Required moment, shear and torque magnitudes must be nonnegative.

Chk_counts.label: Bar / loop count validity
Chk_counts.basis: Nonnegative integer counts and required minimum counts.

Chk_geometry.label: Section input validity
Chk_geometry.basis: Geometry, materials, factors, covers and spacings must be valid.

Chk_min_N.label: Minimum flexural steel — N
Chk_min_N.basis: Minimum required moment resistance / provided resistance.

Chk_strain_N.label: Tension strain screen — N
Chk_strain_N.basis: Required minimum strain (0.005) / calculated tension strain.

Chk_I_N.label: Service I — N
Chk_I_N.basis: Larger of steel stress / limit and actual bar spacing / allowable spacing.

Chk_long_N.label: Longitudinal steel — N
Chk_long_N.basis: Moment + shear/torsion tension / yield resistance of this region's main bars plus effective side steel (half of both side faces).

Chk_min_P.label: Minimum flexural steel — P
Chk_min_P.basis: Minimum required moment resistance / provided resistance.

Chk_strain_P.label: Tension strain screen — P
Chk_strain_P.basis: Required minimum strain (0.005) / calculated tension strain.

Chk_I_P.label: Service I — P
Chk_I_P.basis: Larger of steel stress / limit and actual bar spacing / allowable spacing.

Chk_long_P.label: Longitudinal steel — P
Chk_long_P.basis: Moment + shear/torsion tension / yield resistance of this region's main bars plus effective side steel (half of both side faces).

Chk_min_B.label: Minimum flexural steel — B
Chk_min_B.basis: Minimum required moment resistance / provided resistance.

Chk_strain_B.label: Tension strain screen — B
Chk_strain_B.basis: Required minimum strain (0.005) / calculated tension strain.

Chk_I_B.label: Service I — B
Chk_I_B.basis: Larger of steel stress / limit and nominal combined-row average pitch / allowable. Maximum actual drawn pitch is checked separately by the notebook.

Chk_long_B.label: Longitudinal steel — B
Chk_long_B.basis: Moment + shear/torsion tension / yield resistance of this region's main bars plus effective side steel (half of both side faces).

Chk_shear_G.label: Shear — global
Chk_shear_G.basis: Larger of shear / resistance and nominal demand / section upper bound.

Chk_spacing_G.label: Hoop spacing — global
Chk_spacing_G.basis: Larger of along-cap spacing / limit and transverse leg spacing / limit.

Chk_torsteel_G.label: Shear + torsion steel — global
Chk_torsteel_G.basis: Larger of torsion area per leg / provided leg area and combined area / provided area.

Chk_shear_L.label: Shear — low interval
Chk_shear_L.basis: Larger of shear / resistance and nominal demand / section upper bound.

Chk_spacing_L.label: Hoop spacing — low interval
Chk_spacing_L.basis: Larger of along-cap spacing / limit and transverse leg spacing / limit.

Chk_torsteel_L.label: Shear + torsion steel — low interval
Chk_torsteel_L.basis: Larger of torsion area per leg / provided leg area and combined area / provided area.

Chk_skin_area.label: Skin reinforcement area
Chk_skin_area.basis: Required / provided area on one half-side; N/A when skin steel is not required.

Chk_skin_space.label: Skin reinforcement spacing
Chk_skin_space.basis: Actual skin-bar spacing / allowable spacing, when required.

Chk_shrink_area.label: Shrinkage reinforcement area
Chk_shrink_area.basis: Required area rate / least provided rate across surfaces and directions.

Chk_shrink_space.label: Shrinkage reinforcement spacing
Chk_shrink_space.basis: Largest source surface spacing / allowable shrinkage spacing; bottom uses the between-pile row (Mathcad SP[2]).

Status_III.label: Service III — all regions
Status_III.basis: Largest outer-bar stress / 24 ksi or actual / allowable spacing across N, P and B.

Status_fatigue.label: Fatigue — all regions
Status_fatigue.basis: Largest factored stress range / fatigue threshold across N, P and B.

Status_layout.label: Pile layout source check
Status_layout.basis: Match to the imported force model; REIMPORT means new analysis forces are needed.

Status_section.label: Section source check
Status_section.basis: Match to the imported force model; RECHECK includes self-weight and stiffness.

Status_overall.label: Overall design status
Status_overall.basis: Combined numerical, input, readiness and review conditions. Full status follows the table.
